seeded.name: limit
seeded.description: cmp r0, #0x11 becomes cmp r0, #0x41: the length limit is 64, not 16

seeded.name: subtract
seeded.description: adds r0, r0, r1 becomes subs r0, r0, r1: another return value

note: A limit of the lift, not of the inserted bytes: Ghidra's decompiler treats 0x4000C000 as plain memory and removes the first of the two stores as dead, so the re-lifted function writes the device once. The checked-in fixture for this function is hand-written for the same reason.

Open. On about a quarter of the inputs the intended IR faults and the re-lifted function does not (P1, original-faults); memory, return values and calls agree wherever both finish. Not diagnosed: the function keeps a 5-byte local array, and the re-lift of the recompiled code has other locals, so an out-of-bounds access that depends on the frame is the first thing to rule out.
